goals: Provide fail-closed Xaero entity-head icons for Ribbits through a distinct compatibility companion without changing normal Ribbits rendering or the EMF companion behavior.

Maintain a provider-based Xaero × GeckoLib icon-capture core with explicit opt-in entity selectors; Canary 2 registers only the exact ribbits:ribbit provider and its literal main/body direct-cube rule.

Preserve exact-binary, bounded-cache, render-state, resource-reload, transform, private-asset, and All Rights Reserved boundaries while the statically validated Canary awaits controlled runtime evidence.
scope: Wrap the sole RadarIconForm.getPrerenderer call in Xaero RadarIconCreator.create so only an exact unsupported ribbits:ribbit GeoEntityRenderer can use the Geo-aware provider; preserve upstream vanilla, Ender Dragon, EMF, already-handled, disabled-head, and category-filtered paths.

Reuse Xaero's one fully populated GeckoLib render-state snapshot to resolve the active Ribbit model, baked geometry, profession/Pride state, and texture, then select exactly one top-level main and exactly one direct child body.

Render all and only cubes owned directly by body with inherited static main/body and cube transforms, no descendant or sibling traversal, no model-specific pruning, and framing derived solely from transformed selected-cube bounds.

Use bounded model/texture/profession/Pride/baby-policy/reload cache identity, invalidate successful and FAILED Ribbit cache entries on resource reload, and fail closed to Xaero's ordinary dot/name fallback on any contract or render failure.

Retain and statically validate client-only Canary 2 against exact Xaero 26.4.2, nested XaeroLib 1.7.1, GeckoLib 5.5.1, authoritative Mynx Ribbits C9, Minecraft 26.2, and unaccepted Canary 4 in the combined production classloading harness. Retained failed C3 remains an exact historical binary regression input.

exclusions: Cross-project EMF implementation changes except the explicitly owned companion Canary 4 integration in this reconciliation; future Ribbits-only work must not modify the EMF project.
Changes to projects/ribbits-26.2, its renderer, private resources, artifacts, releases, lifecycle, or runtime evidence.
A dummy vanilla EntityModel or ModelPart facade, whole-body Gecko capture, mutation or replay of the in-world renderer, recursive body rendering, or a generic head-bone heuristic.
Model- or profession-specific cube pruning, automatic support for non-Ribbit GeckoLib entities, or cache keys derived from animation time, transient progress, UUID, or world position.
Redistribution of Xaero All Rights Reserved code/assets, private or donor-derived Ribbits models/textures/manifests, decompiled upstream class bodies, or unlicensed static icon art.
Deployment, Minecraft launch, Test Slot A or B use, accepted-baseline mutation, or any claim of runtime validation for this static candidate.
Modification of the dedicated Workbench profile, runtime-manager state, originals, or any access to the protected Matcha Flavoured 26.1.2 gameplay instance.
